featured_reviews.name: Shubham Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had been servicing my bike here for the last 4-5 years, and even some of my friends used to bring their bikes too. Their regular servicing is okay, but the problem is after-service support. They never help immediately — even if it’s a 5-minute job, they keep saying “come tomorrow, come the day after.” Because of this attitude, almost 5–6 of us have stopped giving our bikes here.

In my case, the same issue kept coming back in my bike. I had to visit again and again, but every time the owner just said “come tomorrow.” When I asked about it, the owner told me they only give 7 days guarantee after servicing. But my bike started showing the same issue within 2–3 days, and again after 4–5 days. On the 8th or 9th day, when I went back, the owner simply refused to take responsibility, saying the guarantee period was over.

This kind of response and careless attitude is very disappointing. The owner really needs to understand how to provide proper service.

2) Pickup Process:

3) Drop‑off:

🔍 Final Verdict:
All said, I would recommend MUMBAI PUNE CAB SERVICE for anyone who needs a reliable vehicle, good customer service, and a smooth pickup/dropoff process.
